content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I recently completed some online courses about [product_name] from [url], and they were excellent. Is there a way to download these training files for offline use?

Hi, As far as I know, downloading those courses isn't possible. However, you can find downloadable videos here, such as 'Simply ingenious. Simply more. Tips and tricks (Video),' which might also be helpful for you.

I've seen those videos and many more—they're really interesting, but I'm specifically looking to use the WBT files offline as well. I don't understand why [company_name] doesn't allow downloading of these files.
You might want to reach out to your [company_name] sales partner and ask for the demo DVD. The WBT files are included there, although I'm not sure if the KNX WBT is already part of it.
The WBT link isn't available offline. [url] This link is working for online access.

analysis.insight_summary: Users recognize the value and practicality of [company_name]'s [product_name] WBT (Web Based Training) courses but are frustrated by the inability to download materials for offline use. The online-only format limits flexibility, and feedback points toward users needing greater accessibility for training resources.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for downloadable versions of [product_name] WBT courses, just like other training materials from [company_name], to facilitate offline learning.
